g.text: Match the OWN hut + sawmill architectural directions. Keep the 3 × 3 collision grid square.
1000² canvas · 4 guide px = 1 world px · verified person 33 world px
FRONT EDGES rise right: Δy / Δx ≈ −0.28
Apply to beams, lintel, sill, eaves and ridge.
LEFT SIDE edges descend right: Δy / Δx ≈ +0.90
2D image directions only — not numerical 3D camera angles.
No rotation or enlargement of the gameplay grid.
Toe must NOT slope past y800.
